name: Excess-attention continuation — buy the dip inside the loud-chatter regime (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: same excess-attention continuation edge, but timed for a better entry: fire when excess-attention-z is elevated (chatter running ahead of dollars → flow still coming) AND price is momentarily statistically stretched to the downside (bb_z below a fitted floor). The thesis is that the attention regime keeps the drift positive over the week, and buying a transient pullback within that regime improves the entry price versus chasing the top of the range. Counterparty is short-term dip sellers who miss the pending flow. DISCONFIRMER: if the generic bb_z dip-buy alone (no excess-attention gate) matches the deflated Sharpe, the attention regime adds nothing, KILL. Neutralize against realized vol/dollar-volume redundancy. Must beat buy-and-hold net of ~7d fees.
catalyst: transient pullback inside a loud-chatter-vs-dollars regime
